hypothesis: The current research loop is being distorted by (1) diagnostics distributions not reflecting persisted event features (e.g., close_location_in_range, upper_wick_share) and (2) inability to join executed_trade events to realized trades for post-filter cohort analysis; fixing these will enable accurate falsification of future post-09:30 signal-quality mechanisms (including geometry and bearish-body confirmations).
mechanism: Implement two observability fixes: (A) Diagnostics generation should compute feature distributions directly from strategy_events.parquet columns (e.g., close_location_in_range, upper_wick_share) using finite-value counts, so distributions cannot show count=0 when the filter clearly used those features to reject 35,769 signals. (B) Persist a stable identifier (trade_id/event_id) into both strategy_events (for executed_trade rows) and trades.csv (and/or persist the realized entry timestamp used in trades.csv into executed_trade events) so we can join and compute PF/median_expectancy for pass/fail cohorts (especially post-09:30 where prior hypotheses focus).

expected_effects.rationale: Observability changes should not alter trading logic; windowed profitability should remain unchanged aside from negligible logging effects.
This is a measurement-only change; PF should remain the same, validating that we didn’t inadvertently change signal/exit behavior.

disqualifiers.name: behavior_change
disqualifiers.condition: profit_factor decreases by more than 1% versus the base experiment (measurement-only change should not move PF materially)

disqualifiers.name: diagnostics_mismatch_persists
disqualifiers.condition: After change, any feature used in a rejection reason (e.g., alert_close_location_reject) still has diagnostics distribution count < 90% of strategy_events finite count

required_diagnostics: diagnostics_feature_distribution_counts_vs_event_non_null_counts: for each distributed feature (close_location_in_range, upper_wick_share), report (diagnostics_count, strategy_events_non_null_count, strategy_events_finite_count) to catch future mismatches
event_trade_join_coverage: fraction of executed_trade events that can be linked to trades.csv (overall and by entry_bucket) after adding join key
post_filter_cohort_report: for any new rejection reason, report executed-trade PF/median_expectancy for pass vs fail cohorts when N>=50
